using LinearAlgebra
using Statistics

function transform_ls(
    x::AbstractArray,
    b::AbstractArray;
    allow_reflection::Bool=false
)::AbstractArray
    @assert size(x, 2) >= size(b, 2)
    @assert size(b, 1) == size(x, 1) "$(size(b, 1)), $(size(x, 1))"
    
    bxt = (transpose(b) * x) / size(b, 1)
    F = svd(bxt)
    u = F.U
    v = F.Vt
    r = u * v
    
    if !allow_reflection
        flip = ones(size(v, 2), 1)
        flip[end, 1] = sign(det(r))
        r = u * (v .* flip)
    end
    
    return r
end

function align(;
    x::AbstractArray,
    y::AbstractArray,
    x_indices::AbstractArray,
    y_indices::AbstractArray
)::AbstractArray
    if length(x_indices) != length(y_indices)
        error(
            "Number of included indices must be the same for both input arrays," *
            " but got for x: $(length(x_indices)), and for y: $(length(y_indices))."
        )
    end
    
    x_mean = mean(x[x_indices .+ 1, :], dims=1)
    y_mean = mean(y[y_indices .+ 1, :], dims=1)
    centered_x = x .- x_mean
    centered_y = y .- y_mean
    t = transform_ls(centered_x[x_indices .+ 1, :], centered_y[y_indices .+ 1, :])
    transformed_x = centered_x * transpose(t) .+ y_mean
    
    return transformed_x
end

function deviations_from_coords(
    decoy_coords::AbstractArray,
    gt_coords::AbstractArray,
    align_idxs::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing}=nothing,
    include_idxs::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing}=nothing
)::AbstractArray
    if size(decoy_coords) != size(gt_coords)
        error(
            "decoy_coords.shape and gt_coords.shape must match.Found: $(size(decoy_coords)) and $(size(gt_coords))."
        )
    end
    
    if isnothing(include_idxs)
        include_idxs = collect(0:size(decoy_coords, 1)-1)
    end
    if isnothing(align_idxs)
        align_idxs = include_idxs
    end
    
    aligned_decoy_coords = align(
        x=decoy_coords,
        y=gt_coords,
        x_indices=align_idxs,
        y_indices=align_idxs
    )
    
    deviations = [norm(aligned_decoy_coords[i+1, :] - gt_coords[i+1, :]) for i in include_idxs]
    
    return deviations
end

function rmsd_from_coords(
    decoy_coords::AbstractArray,
    gt_coords::AbstractArray,
    align_idxs::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing}=nothing,
    include_idxs::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing}=nothing
)::Float64
    deviations = deviations_from_coords(
        decoy_coords, gt_coords, align_idxs, include_idxs
    )
    
    return sqrt(mean(deviations.^2))
end

struct Operation
    trans::AbstractArray
    rot::AbstractArray
    
    function Operation(trans, rot)
        new(trans, rot)
    end
end

function apply_to_coords(op::Operation, coords::AbstractArray)::AbstractArray
    return coords * transpose(op.rot) .+ reshape(op.trans, 1, :)
end

struct Transform
    operations::Vector{Operation}
    chain_ids::Vector{String}
    chain_id_rename_map::Dict{String, String}
    
    function Transform(operations, chain_ids, chain_id_rename_map)
        new(operations, chain_ids, chain_id_rename_map)
    end
end

function apply_to_coords(t::Transform, coords::AbstractArray)::AbstractArray
    for operation in reverse(t.operations)
        coords = apply_to_coords(operation, coords)
    end
    return coords
end

function get_transforms(bd::BioassemblyData, assembly_id::String)
    partial_transforms = []
    all_chain_ids = Set{String}()
    
    for row in bd._pdbx_struct_assembly_gen[assembly_id]
        oper_expression = row["_pdbx_struct_assembly_gen.oper_expression"]
        parsed_oper_id_seqs = parse_oper_expr(oper_expression)
        label_asym_ids = split(row["_pdbx_struct_assembly_gen.asym_id_list"], ',')
        union!(all_chain_ids, label_asym_ids)
        
        for parsed_oper_id_seq in parsed_oper_id_seqs
            push!(partial_transforms, (parsed_oper_id_seq, label_asym_ids))
        end
    end
    
    max_int_chain_id = maximum(str_id_to_int_id(c) for c in all_chain_ids)
    next_int_chain_id = max_int_chain_id + 1
    
    transforms = []
    has_been_renamed = Set{String}()
    
    for (parsed_oper_id_seq, label_asym_ids) in partial_transforms
        chain_id_rename_map = Dict{String, String}()
        
        for label_asym_id in label_asym_ids
            if !(label_asym_id in has_been_renamed)
                chain_id_rename_map[label_asym_id] = label_asym_id
                push!(has_been_renamed, label_asym_id)
            else
                chain_id_rename_map[label_asym_id] = int_id_to_str_id(next_int_chain_id)
                next_int_chain_id += 1
            end
        end
        
        push!(transforms, Transform(
            [bd._operations[oper_id] for oper_id in parsed_oper_id_seq],
            label_asym_ids,
            chain_id_rename_map
        ))
    end
    
    return transforms
end

function rename_label_asym_ids(
    bd::BioassemblyData,
    mapping::Dict{String, String},
    present_chains::Set{String}
)
    new_pdbx_struct_assembly_gen = deepcopy(bd._pdbx_struct_assembly_gen)
    
    for (_, rows) in new_pdbx_struct_assembly_gen
        for row in rows
            old_asym_ids = split(row["_pdbx_struct_assembly_gen.asym_id_list"], ',')
            new_asym_ids = String[
                get(mapping, label_asym_id, label_asym_id)
                for label_asym_id in old_asym_ids
                if label_asym_id in present_chains
            ]
            
            if length(Set(old_asym_ids) ∩ present_chains) != length(Set(new_asym_ids))
                error("Can not rename chains, the new names are not unique: $(sort(new_asym_ids)).")
            end
            
            row["_pdbx_struct_assembly_gen.asym_id_list"] = join(new_asym_ids, ',')
        end
    end
    
    return BioassemblyData(
        pdbx_struct_assembly=deepcopy(bd._pdbx_struct_assembly),
        pdbx_struct_assembly_gen=new_pdbx_struct_assembly_gen,
        pdbx_struct_oper_list=deepcopy(bd._pdbx_struct_oper_list),

mutable struct ArrayView
    base::AbstractArray
    shape::Tuple{Vararg{Int}}
    strides::Tuple{Vararg{Int}}
    offset::Int
    flatten_base::Bool
    
    function ArrayView(base; shape=nothing, strides=nothing, offset=0, flatten_base=true)
        if isnothing(shape)
            shape = size(base)
        end
        if isnothing(strides)
            strides = tuple([prod(shape[i+1:end]) for i in 1:length(shape)]...)
        end
        if length(shape) != length(strides)
            error("`shape` and `strides` must have the same length.")
        end
        if isa(base, AbstractArray)
            if isa(offset, Int)
                if !(0 <= offset < max(length(base), 1))
                    error("Invalid `offset`.")
                end
            end
            if flatten_base
                if length(size(base)) != 1
                    base = reshape(base, (:,))
                end
            end
        end
        new(base, shape, strides, offset, flatten_base)
    end
end

function Base.eltype(av::ArrayView)

end

function Base.size(av::ArrayView)

end

function Base.length(av::ArrayView)

end

end

function offsets(av::ArrayView)

    grid = Iterators.product(idxs...)
    result = zeros(Int, av.shape)
    for (idx, pos) in zip(CartesianIndices(result), grid)
        offset_val = av.offset
        for (i, p) in enumerate(pos)
            offset_val += av.strides[i] * p

    end
    new_shape = tuple(ones(Int, rank - ndims(av))..., av.shape...)
    new_strides = tuple(zeros(Int, rank - ndims(av))..., av.strides...)

    hi = stop < 0 ? ndims(av) + stop : stop
    if hi < lo
        error("Invalid dimension range passed to collapse: $(av.shape) [$(start):$(stop)]")

    new_shape = tuple(av.shape[1:lo]..., -1, av.shape[hi+1:end]...)

function reshape_view(av::ArrayView, target_shape::Tuple; allow_copy::Bool=false)

function _reshape(av::ArrayView, target_shape::Tuple)
    shape_vec = collect(target_shape)
    num_minus_one = count(x -> x == -1, shape_vec)
    if num_minus_one > 0
        if num_minus_one > 1
            error("`shape` may only contain a single `-1` dimension.")
        end
        pos = findfirst(x -> x == -1, shape_vec)
        known_prod = prod(x for x in shape_vec if x != -1)
        shape_vec[pos] = div(length(av), known_prod)
    end
    
    if prod(shape_vec) != length(av)
        error("Mismatched number of elements.")
    end
    
    old_shape = [d for d in av.shape if d != 1]
    old_strides = [s for (i, s) in enumerate(av.strides) if av.shape[i] != 1]
    new_strides = zeros(Int, length(shape_vec))
    
    old_start, old_stop = 1, 2
    new_start, new_stop = 1, 2
    
    while (old_start <= length(old_shape)) && (new_start <= length(shape_vec))
        old_axes_prod = old_shape[old_start]
        new_axes_prod = shape_vec[new_start]
        
        while old_axes_prod != new_axes_prod
            if old_axes_prod < new_axes_prod
                old_axes_prod *= old_shape[old_stop]
                old_stop += 1
            else
                new_axes_prod *= shape_vec[new_stop]
                new_stop += 1
            end
        end
        
        for i in old_start:(old_stop-2)
            if old_strides[i] != old_shape[i+1] * old_strides[i+1]
                error("Cannot combine axes non-contiguous in memory.")
            end
        end
        
        new_strides[new_stop-1] = old_strides[old_stop-1]
        for i in (new_stop-1):-1:(new_start+1)
            new_strides[i-1] = new_strides[i] * shape_vec[i]
        end
        
        old_start, old_stop = old_stop, old_stop + 1
        new_start, new_stop = new_stop, new_stop + 1
    end
    
    return ArrayView(av.base, shape=tuple(shape_vec...), strides=tuple(new_strides...), offset=av.offset)

function Base.split(av::ArrayView, indices_or_sections::Union{Int, Vector{Int}}, axis::Int=1)

            error("Axis size is not divisible by number of sections.")
        end
        chunk = div(av.shape[axis], indices_or_sections)
        indices_or_sections = [i * chunk for i in 1:(indices_or_sections-1)]

    end

abstract type BaseConfig end

mutable struct _Autocreate
    defaults::Dict{Symbol, Any}
    
    function _Autocreate(; kwargs...)
        new(Dict{Symbol, Any}(kwargs))
    end
end

function autocreate(; defaults...)
    return _Autocreate(; defaults...)
end

function strip_optional(t::Type)
    if t isa Union
        args = filter(x -> x != Nothing, Base.uniontypes(t))
        if length(args) == 1
            return args[1]
        end
    end
    return t
end

mutable struct ConfigMeta
    name::Symbol
    fields::Dict{Symbol, Any}
    
    function ConfigMeta(name::Symbol, fields::Dict{Symbol, Any})
        new(name, fields)
    end
end

function coercable_fields(config::BaseConfig)
    result = Dict{Symbol, Tuple{Type, Any}}()
    for (field_name, field_type) in zip(fieldnames(typeof(config)), fieldtypes(typeof(config)))
        field_value = getfield(config, field_name)
        stripped_type = strip_optional(field_type)
        if stripped_type <: BaseConfig
            result[field_name] = (stripped_type, field_value)
        end
    end
    return result
end

function post_init(config::BaseConfig)
    for (field_name, (field_type, field_default)) in coercable_fields(config)
        field_value = getfield(config, field_name)
        if isnothing(field_value)
            continue
        end
        
        try
            if isa(field_value, _Autocreate)
                setfield!(config, field_name, field_type(; field_value.defaults...))
            elseif isa(field_value, Dict)
                args = Dict{Symbol, Any}()
                if isa(field_default, _Autocreate)
                    merge!(args, field_default.defaults)
                end
                merge!(args, field_value)
                setfield!(config, field_name, field_type(; args...))
            end
        catch e
            error("Failure while coercing field $(field_name) of $(typeof(config)): $(e)")
        end
    end
end

function as_dict(config::BaseConfig)
    result = Dict{Symbol, Any}()
    for field_name in fieldnames(typeof(config))
        field_value = getfield(config, field_name)
        if isa(field_value, BaseConfig)
            result[field_name] = as_dict(field_value)
        else
            result[field_name] = field_value
        end
    end
    return result
end

function _per_atom_conditioning(
    config::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig,
    batch,
    name::String
)
    c = config
    
    act = hm_Linear(
        c.per_atom_channels, precision="highest", name="$(name)_embed_ref_pos"
    )(batch.ref_structure.positions)
    
    act += hm_Linear(c.per_atom_channels, name="$(name)_embed_ref_mask")(
        Float32.(batch.ref_structure.mask[:, :, [1]])
    )
    
    act += hm_Linear(c.per_atom_channels, name="$(name)_embed_ref_element")(
        jax.nn.one_hot(batch.ref_structure.element, 128)
    )
    
    act += hm_Linear(c.per_atom_channels, name="$(name)_embed_ref_charge")(
        asinh.(batch.ref_structure.charge[:, :, [1]])
    )
    
    atom_name_chars_1hot = jax.nn.one_hot(batch.ref_structure.atom_name_chars, 64)
    num_token, num_dense, _ = size(act)
    act += hm_Linear(c.per_atom_channels, name="$(name)_embed_ref_atom_name")(
        reshape(atom_name_chars_1hot, num_token, num_dense, :)
    )
    
    act .*= Float32.(batch.ref_structure.mask[:, :, [1]])
    
    row_act = hm_Linear(
        c.per_atom_pair_channels, name="$(name)_single_to_pair_cond_row"
    )(jax.nn.relu(act))
    
    col_act = hm_Linear(
        c.per_atom_pair_channels, name="$(name)_single_to_pair_cond_col"
    )(jax.nn.relu(act))
    
    pair_act = row_act[:, :, [1], :] .+ col_act[:, [1], :, :]
    
    pair_act += hm_Linear(
        c.per_atom_pair_channels,
        precision="highest",
        name="$(name)_embed_pair_offsets"
    )(
        batch.ref_structure.positions[:, :, [1], :] .- 
        batch.ref_structure.positions[:, [1], :, :]
    )
    
    sq_dists = sum(
        (batch.ref_structure.positions[:, :, [1], :] .- 
         batch.ref_structure.positions[:, [1], :, :]).^2,
        dims=4
    )
    
    pair_act += hm_Linear(
        c.per_atom_pair_channels, name="$(name)_embed_pair_distances"
    )(1.0 ./ (1 .+ sq_dists[:, :, :, [1]]))
    
    return act, pair_act
end
